_comment: Expected SHA-256 hashes for the databases MarkerFinder verifies. Keys are the names verify_database() reports; each value is the combined hash computed exactly the way DatabaseVersionManager.verify_database() computes it - sha256 over the concatenation of the per-file SHA-256 digests of every file under db/<name>, in sorted path order. Regenerate after a deliberate database update with: python -c "from markerfinder.utils.db_versioning import DatabaseVersionManager as M; print(M('db').verify_database('gtdb_markers', 'db/gtdb_markers')['hash'])", or run scripts/fetch_marker_db.py --record.
_recorded: 2026-09-29, MarkerFinder 0.1.0, db/gtdb_markers = bac120 + ar53 profile directories assembled by scripts/fetch_marker_db.py
_note_gtdb_markers: db/gtdb_markers/ is git-ignored: the TIGRFAM/Pfam profiles are third-party work and are assembled locally by scripts/fetch_marker_db.py. This hash is the reference that build produced, so --check tells a user whose profiles differ (another upstream version, another split) that the database on disk is not the one this release was validated against. It is a WARN, not a hard failure.
_note_marker_hmm: Left empty on purpose: the TIGRFAM/Pfam library used by --marker-mode hmm is not shipped with this release (it is downloaded by the user), so a hash for it would be an unverifiable claim. --check reports an empty entry as NOT RUN rather than as a pass.
